name: Banjaar Tola (Taj Safari)
location: Banjar river bank, Mukki zone, Kanha National Park
why_special: Taj Safari's Kanha flagship — 18 luxury tented suites in two camps along the Banjar river. Open verandahs face the water, naturalist-led drives into Mukki zone (Kanha's quieter side). Closed during monsoon (June 30 - October 1).

name: Singinawa Jungle Lodge
why_special: Tripadvisor 5.0/5 — Latika Nath's 100-acre lodge bordering the reserve. 12 cottages on 55 acres of grasslands, water holes and forest. Naturalist-led drives, on-site library and pool. The reference luxury Kanha stay alongside Banjaar Tola.

name: Kanha Earth Lodge
location: Patpara village, 25 min from Khatia gate, Kanha
why_special: Pugdundee Safaris' Kanha property — 12 luxury cottages inspired by Gond tribal architecture with open verandahs facing the forest. Built with recycled materials, dedicated naturalists. The Khatia-side luxury counterpoint to Mukki-side Singinawa.

name: Kipling Camp
location: Mocha village, near Khatia/Kisli gate, Kanha
why_special: Founded 1982 by the Wright family — Kanha's pioneer eco-camp with 18 cottages in a 30-acre sal forest. Home to Tara the elephant (subject of Mark Shand's 'Travels on My Elephant'). Old-India naturalist tradition; one of the few lodges that still feels British-era.

name: Kanha Jungle Lodge
why_special: Tripadvisor 4.9/5 across 456 reviews — 11-acre riverside lodge with 18 rooms near Mukki gate. Long-standing mid-tier with reliable naturalists and a swimming pool. Books out 60+ days ahead for Nov-Mar peak.

name: Shergarh Tented Camp
location: Baherakhar village, Khatia gate side, Kanha
why_special: Owner-operated 6-tent boutique camp on a 9-acre forest plot — one of Kanha's most awarded eco-lodges. Knowledgeable naturalists, family-run kitchen, no children under 12. Closed June 16 - October 16.

name: MPT Baghira Jungle Resort (Mocha)
location: Mocha village, near Khatia/Kisli gate, Kanha
why_special: MP Tourism's flagship Khatia-side property (opened 2014 to replace the original Baghira Log Huts which the Supreme Court closed in 2016 for being inside the core zone). Cottages and AC rooms with a multi-cuisine restaurant. Book direct via mptourism.com.

name: MPT Safari Lodge Mukki
location: Mukki gate, beside Banjar river, Kanha
why_special: MP Tourism's Mukki-side property — beside the Banjar river surrounded by dense forest. Rooms with forest views, bird-watching from the property. Less crowded than the Khatia-side MPT. Book direct via mptourism.com.

name: Tuli Tiger Corridor (Tuli Tiger Resort)
why_special: Tuli Group's 40-room Victorian-style resort on the Banjar river, Mukki side. Pool, spa, multi-cuisine restaurant. The closest the Mukki gate gets to a polished mid-luxury property with capacity for large groups and families.
